name: dsh-netease-lyrics
description: Top floating lyric island for DeepSeek Harness: reads the current SMTC media session (NetEase Cloud Music via BetterNCM + InfLink-rs, QQ Music, or any SMTC player), matches the track against NetEase's public search with QQ Music as automatic fallback, and renders the current lyric line in a hover-expandable capsule. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: node test/multisource.test.mjs && node test/lyric-service.test.mjs && node test/client-ui.test.mjs && node test/playback-clock.test.mjs && node test/drag-position.test.mjs && node test/lyric-transition.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/lyric-service.js
